Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES
PR: #250
Head: 84ca653e3c101153e06b890a8ee2ffb512eac5c7
Request: 01a1f186-e939-7b43-9b0c-884701ae5d5f

No high-confidence new exploitable vulnerability was found in the four changed files: .copilot/extensions/pij/extension.mjs, its extension.test.mjs, docs/difficulties.md, and docs/how/copilot-native-extension.md. Review grades the registration repair against its base, under the C33 same-user trust boundary and C34 scope. No source changes, local builds, or local tests were performed.

Installed SDK receipts
- The actual extracted CLI runtime is 1.0.114-0. Its bundled copilot-sdk/extension.js:20137-20170 forwards joinSession configuration without adapting the old shape; :18146 reads config2.tools?.definitions and :18172-18173 reads config2.hooks?.handlers. registerTools at :14154-14177 and registerHooks/dispatch at :14863-14866 and :14980-15017 confirm the callbacks they consume.
- The declarations agree: copilot-sdk/extension.d.ts:6-9, types.d.ts:3178-3190 (SessionToolOptions.definitions), and :3688-3693 (SessionHookOptions.handlers).
- Installed 1.0.114 does not accept the old flat shape on this path: it silently registers no definitions or hook handlers. Cached 1.0.113-0/-1 use the nested accesses too.
- Cached 1.0.112-0 uses flat tools/hooks (bundled extension.js:17946,17975; types.d.ts:2498,2812). This patch has no legacy fallback and does not support that API. docs/how/copilot-native-extension.md:44-49 explicitly documents CLI >=1.0.113. A fallback is not required within that support minimum; older CLI compatibility must not be claimed.

Registration completeness and PR247
- extension.mjs:91-143 places pij_send under tools.definitions; :148-158 and :161-172 place onUserPromptSubmitted and onAgentStop under hooks.handlers. None of these remains flat.
- The wildcard precedence and turn-end observers at :182-183, session.shutdown at :184, and process shutdown handlers at :68-84 remain unchanged.
- store.mjs:1538-1580 retains the bridge wildcard subscription. Its activity reducer at :2220-2235 still publishes working on root turn start/fusion routing and idle on session.idle/fusion completion/abort, not assistant.turn_end. These SDK event subscriptions are separate from configurable hook handlers and survive the nesting change.

Security boundary
- pij_send retains schema and session guards (extension.mjs:97-140), independent store validation of string/nonempty recipient and body, force/FYI incompatibility, force reason, destination and reply ID, and a payload bound to the registered sender (store.mjs:2345-2390).
- Destination parsing (:986-1006) and JSON serialization (:650-668) do not interpolate recipient/body into shell commands or request URLs. No permission-approval hook or skipPermission option was added. The installed SDK's ordinary tool default remains no-result (bundled extension.js:12497-12499).
- Restored onAgentStop uses the existing turn-end parser/dispatcher: crates/core/src/turn_end.rs:175-239 performs no shell expansion; crates/daemon/src/http/turn_end.rs:249-285 retains the existing verbs and caller checks.
- store.mjs:2291-2305 passes the daemon FYI block verbatim as additionalContext, not modifiedPrompt or a permission decision. crates/core/src/fyi.rs:249-265 renders numbered sender/time-attributed entries and indents continuation lines. This is attributed peer data, not sanitization or proof of model resistance to prompt injection. The renderer, passthrough and handler bodies are unchanged against base; the patch restores their registration and introduces no new body-to-authority transformation.
- No new dependency/lockfile source, credential-reading behavior, or credential material was introduced.

Proof and non-blocking limits
- just pr-freeze 250: PASS, FINAL at the exact full head; ls-remote and gh agree, base main, CLEAN, ready, latest checks pass, and migrations/delivers are satisfied.
- Exact-head CI run 44440232882: success, including Node 22 and 24 check jobs plus rust-lint and rust-test. just copilot-native-test passed 357/357 on each Node version, 0 failed and 0 skipped. The inspected CI log includes the typed-prompt FYI claim and session.idle behavior contracts. Delivers run 44440233039 also succeeded.
- No local harness boot/checks, builds, tests, SDK execution, or live attachment canary was run, as requested. This review's installed SDK evidence is source/type inspection, not a new live runtime witness.
- extension.test.mjs:99-124 correctly mirrors today's nested lookups and missing-handler behavior, but its resolver at :164-170 substitutes a handwritten fake. It does not import the real SDK or its types. The fake catches an extension regression against today's copied contract; it cannot detect the next external SDK shape change. These .mjs files are also outside tsconfig.json:18's include. A real supported-SDK registration canary is a non-blocking harness follow-up, not a security finding or a gate for this repair.
- No new recurring loop, polling interval, or process launch is added. The repair re-enables event-driven prompt/stop hooks and on-demand tool handling; existing receiver/heartbeat scheduling is unchanged. This is not a measured runtime-cost verdict.

Harness feedback
magicWand: a CI canary against the supported real Copilot SDK that proves tools and both hooks are actually registered, so upstream shape drift fails deterministically instead of requiring a live incident and manual source inspection.
difficulties: today's fake and stale public examples cannot independently establish the installed runtime contract; read-only inspection of the extracted SDK implementation and declarations supplied that missing evidence. Observation MW-001 captured the gap. This recommendation is preserved here without modifying the reviewed worktree.
